control.name: CONTROL — stop failing a bot/App slug ambient login (a fall-through could post as a bot and pass)

mutations.name: flip the no-usable-human answers (not logged in / 401 / 403) back to could-not-check in the check — the #1798 defect: the safe state unreachable
flip the integration-token HTTP 403 classification back to could-not-check in the probe
flip the gh-not-logged-in classification back to could-not-check in the probe
mutations.old: case exitCode == ghExitAuthRequired || strings.Contains(low, "gh auth login"):
mutations.new: case false && (exitCode == ghExitAuthRequired || strings.Contains(low, "gh auth login")):

mutations.name: flip the HTTP 401 classification back to could-not-check in the probe (the planted second instance of the class)
drop the rate-limit carve-out (a rate-limited HUMAN token's 403 would read as no ambient identity)
drop the human-ambient WARNING (a human login passes silently)
make a human ambient login blocking again (the pre-#1798 red on a non-blessing human)
skip the transport half once the identity half passes (the helper chain goes unchecked)
mutations.old: c := checkAmbientTransport(p, l, tokenPath, identity, refs)

mutations.name: treat a gh exec failure as a no-identity answer (could-not-run rounded up to clean)
mutations.old: return "", fmt.Errorf("could not run gh api user: %v", oneLine(err.Error()))
mutations.new: return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: could not run gh api user: %v", ErrNoAmbientIdentity, oneLine(err.Error()))

mutations.name: drop the timeout detection (a hung gh stops being reported as a timeout)
mutations.old:
if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("gh api user did not answer within %s", ambientProbeTimeout)
mutations.new:
if false && ctx.Err() != nil {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("gh api user did not answer within %s", ambientProbeTimeout)
